title: From attention to object
governingQuestion: Where does the runway meet the order—and who owns the data?
editorialHook: A regulation can shape the garment without belonging to Fashion Week.
longformOutline: Separate historic line-sheet practice, unverified current platform adoption, and the enacted EU product-passport framework.
verticalScriptBrief: Show the sentence “ESPR is not a BFC plan,” then trace regulation → future delegated rules → product data.
interactiveSpecification: Product Data Boundary: inspect identifier, material, actor, provenance, and missing field against the enacted-law context.
objectAndRightsBrief: Locate a permissioned historic line sheet or create an original schema diagram; no vendor UI screenshot without review.
teachingPrompt: How do we distinguish an enacted framework, a delegated requirement, a vendor product, and an actual brand deployment?
communityCallout: Request redacted line sheets and confirmed season-specific showroom workflows.
accessibilityPlan: Publish transcript/captions for time media; alt text or explicit designed-absence label; keyboard path for the interactive; no status conveyed by color alone.
releaseGates: Every positive claim resolves to cited support
Every media object has item-level rights disposition
Open gaps remain visible in copy and end cards
Named worker/interview consent recorded before quotation
mediaPolicy: OA/licensed/original/authorized embed only; selected documentary object installed with exact source-level treatment
status: evidence-backed production package; interviews and unresolved future reporting remain open

finishedLongform.headline: From attention to object
finishedLongform.opening: The runway becomes a business when attention meets an order. Between those moments sit line sheets, showrooms, buyer journeys, identifiers, product data and systems whose adoption is often claimed more quickly than it can be proved.
sections: The BFC’s 2021 web tender explicitly designed retailer and buyer journeys around e-commerce, wholesale, digital showrooms and orders.
A platform requirement is not proof that every proposed function was deployed or adopted by every brand.
The EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation is enacted context for digital product passports, not a BFC plan.
The missing historic object remains a London-specific line sheet with item-level reuse permission.
finishedLongform.closing: Use Product Data Boundary to separate law, standard, vendor and deployment.

spokenScript: Soon, product data may travel farther.
But a regulation is not a rollout.
And a vendor is not adoption.
